papers.title: A defect-based critical plane method for multiaxial high cycle fatigue life prediction in L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Aerospace Engineering, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Nanjing 210016, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yingyu Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Aerospace Engineering, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Nanjing 210016, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文直接针对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的多轴高周疲劳寿命预测，符合Layer 1对疲劳性能的要求。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高含缺陷L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V多轴高周疲劳寿命预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于缺陷的临界平面法，结合多轴疲劳准则。
summary_zh.result: 新方法能准确预测不同缺陷状态下的疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 通过L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V试样多轴疲劳实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve multiaxial high-cycle fatigue life prediction for L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V by incorporating defect characteristics into the critical plane approach.
summary_en.method: A defect-based critical plane model is developed, integrating defect size, shape, and orientation with multiaxial fatigue criteria.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields accurate fatigue life predictions for L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V under various multiaxial loading conditions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental multiaxial fatigue tests on L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V specimens with controlled defect populations validate the model.

papers.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of the TC4 Alloy Obtained by Equal-Channel Angular Pressing in Combination with Reversible Hydrogen Alloying
papers.abstract: This paper studies the effect of reversible hydrogen alloying of the TC4 alloy on the microstructure, phase composition, and mechanical properties before and after equal-channel angular pressing. It is shown that the introduction of 0.3% hydrogen followed by quenching from a temperature of 850 °C leads to the formation of a thin-plate α″-martensite, which made it possible to implement 6 passes (ε ~ 4.2) of pressing at 600 °C. As a result of the deformation of the TC4-H alloy and subsequent thermal vacuum treatment to remove hydrogen, an ultrafine-grained structure with an average size of the α-phase of 0.15 μm was formed, which led to strengthening of the alloy to 1490 MPa with a relative elongation of about 5% at room temperature. The reasons for a more significant refinement of the grain/subgrain structure and an increase in the tensile strength of the hydrogenated alloy after equal-channel angular pressing in comparison with hydrogen-free TC4 alloy are discussed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是TC4合金的等通道角压及可逆氢合金化，并非增材制造，与用户关注方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not involve any additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED) process; it uses ECAP, a severe plastic deformation method, which is outside the scope of AM mechanical/fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究可逆氢合金化对TC4合金等通道角压后组织及力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在850℃淬火引入0.3%氢形成α″-马氏体，在600℃进行6道次等通道角压，再通过真空除氢获得超细晶组织。
summary_zh.result: 获得了平均α相尺寸0.15μm的超细晶结构，抗拉强度达1490MPa，延伸率约5%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和微观组织观察验证性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of reversible hydrogen alloying on the microstructure and mechanical properties of TC4 alloy after equal-channel angular pressing.
summary_en.method: Introduction of 0.3% hydrogen followed by quenching from 850°C to form thin-plate α″-martensite, then 6 passes of ECAP at 600°C, followed by vacuum degassing to obtain an ultrafine-grained structure.
summary_en.result: An ultrafine-grained structure with average α-phase size of 0.15 μm was achieved, leading to a tensile strength of 1490 MPa and elongation of about 5%.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructure analysis validated the strengthening effect.

papers.title: Machining parameters optimization in high-speed milling of titanium alloy chips
papers.abstract: High-speed cutting of titanium alloy has the advantages of high processing efficiency, reducing tool wear, and obtaining good surface quality, but there is a lack of research on the influence of chip shape on machining parameter selection mechanism in the cutting process, which hinders the development of high-speed milling quality of titanium alloy. In this paper, the shape of titanium alloy (Ti6Al4V) chips at different speeds and different temperatures were simulated. With the increase of cutting speed, the tool squeezes the workpiece material, causing it to undergo elastic deformation and thereby forming a cutting layer. As the cutting process progresses, the chip gradually takes on a serrated shape, the degree of sawtooth sharpening of chips was analyzed. The formation mechanism of chips and the formation process of sawtooth chips during right-angle cutting were analyzed. The locust optimization algorithm was used to optimize the multi-objective parameters, and it was found that high performance machining effect could be achieved by using large feed speed, radial cutting depth and spindle speed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛合金高速铣削的切屑形态模拟和参数优化，但未研究后处理对疲劳或力学性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on chip shape simulation and machining parameter optimization, but does not evaluate the effect of these parameters on fatigue life or mechanical performance of Ti-6Al-4V after machining. No experimental mechanical testing or correlation with surface integrity or fatigue.

summary_zh.motivation: 高速铣削钛合金时切屑形状对加工参数选择的影响机制缺乏研究。
summary_zh.method: 通过模拟不同速度和温度下的切屑形状，并使用蝗虫优化算法优化多目标参数。
summary_zh.result: 发现大进给速度、径向切削深度和主轴转速可实现高效加工。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: The influence of chip morphology on machining parameter selection during high-speed milling of titanium alloy is not well understood.
summary_en.method: Chip shapes at various speeds and temperatures are simulated, and the locust optimization algorithm is used for multi-objective parameter optimization.
summary_en.result: High feed speed, radial depth of cut, and spindle speed are identified for achieving high-performance machining.
summary_en.validation: The study relies solely on numerical simulation without experimental validation.
